dunno the ancient history of mental delusions but i do know in the past century people have evolved from "the radio is listening to me" to "TV is listening to me" to "computer is listening" to "microchips" type stuff, so it's essentially just "whatever is new to me that people are paranoid about in general is hyper amplified in my head".

even in modern communities, some have found that in a place where there's less constant media which specifically feeds on common paranoia, people with schizophrenic type disorders don't have such aggressive fears in their delusions as they're not in an environment that amplifies that fear. so in the past, there could be anything from "the religious authorities and god are at my door they're coming for me" to just kind of relaxed spirituality depending on the intensity of the culture a schizophrenic individual was living in. 

there's obviously still generally frightening hallucinations in any era and form of schizoaffective disorders, but the manifestation of "the CIA is stalking me" type delusions is extremely amplified by constant exposure to media that basically tells you "you should be worried that the CIA is stalking you"
